newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: RANDSTAD SEES SALES QUADRUPLING IN 10 YRS.
newsitem.headline: RANDSTAD SEES SALES QUADRUPLING IN 10 YRS.

text.p: Temporary employment agency Randstad NV said on Tuesday it expected its sales to quadruple over the next 10 years.
Chairman Frits Goldschmeding said this forecast referred only to organic growth of sales and did not take into account any future acquisitions.
Asked by reporters if profit growth would keep pace with sales growth, Goldschmeding said they would.
"24 billion guilders (in annual sales) should be possible within 10 years," Goldschmeding told a news conference.
In 1996 Randstad had sales of 5.95 billion guilders and made a net profit of 207.4 million guilders.
